accepted.question_text: In the D1-D5 AdS3/CFT2 correspondence, which correlators of chiral primary operators beyond the single-particle three-point functions already matched are protected by non-renormalization theorems? The problem includes determining whether extremal and next-to-extremal n-point functions, and three-point functions involving multi-particle chiral primaries, match across string theory on AdS3 x S3 x X4, the symmetric-orbifold CFT, and supergravity once the necessary nonlinear operator mixings are included.

evidence.quote: One might wish to explore whether other correlators are protected by non-renormalization theorems.

accepted.question_text: Can the relation between supergravity holographic renormalization and the string-theory computation of AdS3/CFT2 correlators be made systematic, so that the volume renormalization that renders string correlators finite and the map between worldsheet vertex operators and CFT operators are understood as precisely as the corresponding bulk-field boundary-condition dictionary in supergravity?

evidence.quote: renormalization has not been systematically developed and applied in this context.
